nodes.label: Minima Core launcher icon (xhdpi) — stock Android Studio template icon: white Android robot head (bugdroid) silhouette with a drop shadow, centered on a green background overlaid with a light grid pattern. This is the default adaptive-icon placeholder generated by Android Studio, NOT Minima-specific branding; the org.minimarex.minimacore base app ships with unreplaced template art at this density.
